QR scanned, but the computer could not be reached. Keep the My phone window open.

With Hyper-V, the phone may not reach a VM behind Default Switch/NAT. Try an External switch connected to your router network. Sharing the same router is not enough.

Check that Windows Firewall allows Kvieta on the private/local network only; do not disable the firewall.
QR scanned, but the computer identity could not be verified. Check both device clocks and create a fresh QR code. Security verification was not bypassed.
QR scanned, but pairing did not finish. Create a fresh QR code in My phone on your computer and try again.
